name: HC-HIPAA Critical-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 1: strong PHI signature with an identity anchor. Single record reportable: immediate investigation. Block-grade; ships DISABLED at INFO, raise to HIGH when enabled.
engines: HIPAA Critical (Strong Signature and Clinical Document)

name: HC-HIPAA Narrative Low Volume-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 2: short-form clinical content with a name and a second identifier. Single record reportable; monitor first because referral and prior-authorization traffic to payers is legitimate.

name: HC-HIPAA Identity Trifecta-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 3: name + DOB + SSN (or licence / TIN). Reportable under state breach law regardless of healthcare context. Block-grade.

name: HC-HIPAA Sensitive Subcategory-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 4: SUD, mental health, HIV, genetic and reproductive PHI beside an identifier. 42 CFR Part 2 and GINA: route to the restricted reviewer queue (attach a dedicated notification template and auditor). Block-grade.

name: HC-HIPAA Pharmacy Claims Billing-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 5: e-prescribing, pharmacy fills, claims, EOBs, prior authorizations and EDI. Monitor first: watch the false-positive rate of the merged pharmacy and claims pathways (Insurance Document and Credit Cards especially), and exclude the clearing house.

name: HC-HIPAA Bulk PHI Major-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 6 MAJOR tier (> 500 identifiers): a potential 500+ individual breach. Bypass tier-2 review: Privacy Officer, legal counsel, executive incident response and forensics; breach risk assessment within 1 hour. Block-grade.

name: HC-HIPAA Bulk PHI Significant-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 6 significant tier (> 50 identifiers): executive escalation and immediate forensic investigation; still under the 500-individual notification threshold. Block-grade.

name: HC-HIPAA Bulk PHI Small-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 6 small tier (> 1 identifiers): any multi-record exposure. Standard tier-2 review; investigate and document for the annual HHS log.

name: HC-US PII-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 7: US PII (SSN, TIN, driver's licence, alien registration, passport, date of birth) from the Fed pack. Reportable under state breach law regardless of healthcare context.

name: HC-US PHI Medium Confidence-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 8: medical content plus one identifier (Fed pack US PHI - Medium Confidence). Second PHI opinion beside Engine 1.

name: HC-US PHI High Confidence-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 9: dense medical content plus five identifiers, or an identifier beside its label (Fed pack US PHI - High Confidence). Block-grade.

name: HC-Financial Information-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP, Engine 10: payment card, routing-number and tax-form data (Fed pack Financial Information). PCI DSS scope beside HIPAA. Monitor-only.

name: HC-HIPAA Critical [Endpoint]
description: Endpoint DLP: the same detection as the inline rule "HC-HIPAA Critical-Monitor" (HIPAA Critical (Strong Signature and Clinical Document)). Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.
engines: HIPAA Critical (Strong Signature and Clinical Document)
